```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Set up the report runtime environment and load the shared pipeline functions.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# Locate the pipeline root from the Rmd file location or the working directory (compatible with both render and interactive runs; does not rely on .git/.Rproj).
input_dir <- tryCatch(
  dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), mustWork = FALSE)),
  error = function(e) ""
)
root_candidates <- unique(normalizePath(
  c(input_dir, getwd(), file.path(getwd(), "snRNAseq_publication_pipeline")),
  mustWork = FALSE
))
pipeline_root <- root_candidates[
  file.exists(file.path(root_candidates, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
][1]
if (is.na(pipeline_root)) {
  stop("Cannot locate the pipeline root containing R/pipeline_helpers.R", call. = FALSE)
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = pipeline_root)
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
```

## Configuration

```{r libraries}
# Read export settings from the centralized parameter file.
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "config", "pipeline_params.R"))

# Check and load the packages required for result collation and file export.
check_packages(c("dplyr", "readr", "stringr", "here"))

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

paths <- get_pipeline_paths(project_root = dirname(pipeline_root))
# The publication_ready directory centrally stores figures and tables ready for direct use in manuscripts and presentations.
pub_root <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$pipeline_root, "outputs", "publication_ready"))
pub_fig_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(pub_root, "figures"))
pub_table_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(pub_root, "tables"))
```

## Copy publication outputs

```{r copy_outputs}
# Collect all PDF/PNG figures and CSV tables generated by the preceding steps.
figure_files <- list.files(paths$fig_dir, pattern = "\\.(pdf|png)$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
table_files <- list.files(paths$table_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

# When copying files, embed the subdirectory names in the file names so identically named files from different steps do not overwrite each other.
copy_with_prefix <- function(files, out_dir) {
  copied <- lapply(files, function(path) {
    rel <- sub(paste0("^", paths$fig_dir, "/?"), "", path)
    rel <- sub(paste0("^", paths$table_dir, "/?"), "", rel)
    out_name <- gsub("[/\\\\]", "__", rel)
    out_path <- file.path(out_dir, out_name)
    file.copy(path, out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
    data.frame(Source = path, Exported = out_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
    dplyr::bind_rows(copied)
}

fig_export <- copy_with_prefix(figure_files, pub_fig_dir)
table_export <- copy_with_prefix(table_files, pub_table_dir)

# Save export manifests for figures and tables so the origin of each publication_ready file can be traced.
write.csv(fig_export, file.path(pub_root, "publication_figure_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(table_export, file.path(pub_root, "publication_table_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Combined DEG table

```{r combined_deg}
# Collect the edgeR pseudobulk DEG tables from step 05.
deg_files <- list.files(
  file.path(paths$table_dir, "05_Pseudobulk_DEG"),
  pattern = "_edgeR_pseudobulk_DEG\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

combined_deg <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(deg_files, function(path) {
  x <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  x$SourceFile <- basename(path)
  x
}))

if (nrow(combined_deg) > 0) {
# After merging, sort by tissue, cell type, and FDR, and additionally export the top DEGs for each cell type.
  combined_deg <- combined_deg |>
    dplyr::arrange(Tissue, CellType, FDR, dplyr::desc(abs(logFC)))

  top_deg <- combined_deg |>
    dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Tissue, CellType) |>
    dplyr::slice_min(order_by = FDR, n = top_n_deg_per_celltype, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  write.csv(combined_deg, file.path(pub_table_dir, "Table_pseudobulk_edgeR_all_DEG.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(top_deg, file.path(pub_table_dir, "Table_pseudobulk_edgeR_top_significant_DEG.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Combined enrichment table

```{r combined_enrichment}
# Collect the GO/KEGG enrichment results from step 06, excluding summary files.
enrich_files <- list.files(
  file.path(paths$table_dir, "06_Pseudobulk_Enrichment"),
  pattern = "\\.(csv)$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
enrich_files <- enrich_files[!grepl("summary", basename(enrich_files), ignore.case = TRUE)]

combined_enrichment <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(enrich_files, function(path) {
  x <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  x$SourceFile <- basename(path)
  x
}))

if (nrow(combined_enrichment) > 0) {
# Merge all enrichment entries to enable unified filtering and table curation.
  combined_enrichment <- combined_enrichment |>
    dplyr::arrange(SourceFile, p.adjust)
  write.csv(combined_enrichment, file.path(pub_table_dir, "Table_GO_KEGG_from_pseudobulk_DEG.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Output manifest

```{r manifest}
# Generate a master manifest of all exported files under the publication_ready directory.
manifest <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  fig_export |> dplyr::mutate(Type = "Figure"),
  table_export |> dplyr::mutate(Type = "Table")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(File = basename(Exported)) |>
  dplyr::select(Type, File, Source, Exported)

write.csv(manifest, file.path(pub_root, "publication_ready_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
manifest
```
